title: 2 October 2014: Paul McCartney live at United Spirit Arena, Lubbock, Texas
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the United Spirit Arena in Lubbock, Texas, USA, on 2 October 2014.

It was the 52nd show of the Out There Tour, which lasted for 91 dates between May 2013 and October 2015. This concert was seen by 11,446 fans.

Howdy #Lubbock we're on in a few. Honored to have met Buddy Holly's family backstage. Lucky day.

— Brian Ray (@brianrayguitar) October 3, 2014

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).

It was a special night in Lubbock last night. Paul told a few stories even I hadn't heard. Thank you all!

— Brian Ray (@brianrayguitar) October 3, 2014

The setlist included a special tribute to Buddy Holly, with a cover version of ‘It’s So Easy!’.
